$comment: Sites that splice the `https://jmrp.io/#person` node into their own @graph.
All of them read the canonical document from raw.githubusercontent at build
time and keep `snapshotPath` as an offline fallback;
scripts/ci/propagate-identity.mjs rewrites it when the canonical changes.
`buildPathPrefix` is the prefix that repo's Pages push trigger watches. The
snapshot lives inside it on purpose: the commit itself then starts their
build, with no extra call. If a repo is restructured and stops honouring
that, the script falls back to `dispatchWorkflow`. An empty prefix means the
workflow has no path filter, so any push starts it.
Adding a consumer is adding an entry here.
